test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: By selling an article for Rs. 33,000 a man gains 10%. To get a profit of 20%, he has to sell it for :
solution:
**Given:**

S.P = Rs.33,000

Profit% = 10%

**Concept used:**

C.P = S.P/{100 ± (P/L)%}

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

⇒ 110% = 33,000

⇒ 1 % = 33,000/110

⇒ 100% = 30,000

Required S.P = 30,000 × 120% = Rs.36,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.36,000.**
